cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — perched on a ledge or edge; the yard of a Han-era relay station — standing; a bus shelter on a quiet street — holds a cup in both hands; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a folding fan open near her chest; her bedroom — standing; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — chest-deep in the water; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — sitting on the ground; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench — seated sideways on a stool or bench; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing
